hypotheses.claim: Attribute.js bails out on any reference whose binding is an EachBlock index, even when the reference is shadowed inside the callback's own body (inner const index), so B cannot be hoisted. Fix: when the reference resolves to a local (inner) scope within the target function, skip the EachBlock/each checks.
evidence_refs: issue: B with `const index` inside handler is not hoisted while C (renamed i) is

hypotheses.prediction: Guarding the EachBlock-index bail so references shadowed within the target function no longer bail makes B compile as `[on_click]` while C stays hoisted and A stays inline.
